name: Summoner Circle
description: Choose a summoner circle. Your circle determines the portfolio from which you summon minions and many later class features. (Quick Build: Circle of Graves.)

options.description: You call forth demons from the Abyssal Waste.
You raise undead creatures from the Necropolitan Ruin.
You beckon pixies, nixies, and sprites from Arcadia.

name: Minions
description: You can summon and maintain up to eight minions and manage up to two squads. A squad can contain up to eight minions with the same name. Your Summoner's Range is 5 + your Reason score. Manage active squads from the Minion Squads panel on your hero sheet.

name: Essence
description: You and your minions have a unique reserve of essence as your Heroic Resource.

in_combat.name: Essence in Combat
in_combat.description: At the start of a combat encounter, you gain essence equal to your Victories. At the start of each of your turns during combat, you gain 2 essence. The first time each round that any minion dies unwillingly within your Summoner's Range, you gain 1 essence. You lose remaining essence at the end of the encounter.

out_of_combat.name: Essence Outside of Combat
out_of_combat.description: You can't gain essence outside combat, but can use essence-costing heroic abilities and effects without spending it. After doing so, you can't use that same ability or effect outside combat again until you gain a Victory or finish a respite.

name: Summoner Strike
description: You have a magical melee or ranged strike that replaces both your melee and ranged free strikes.

name: Strike For Me
description: You have a free triggered action that directs your minions to make free strikes or use signature abilities.

name: Minion Bridge
description: You can command your minions to form a bridge or other connected route.

name: Formation
description: Your minion squads act together on your turn.

name: Quick Command
description: You can give your minions commands as described by the Summoner class.

name: Summoner Abilities
description: You gain heroic abilities that use essence and interact with your minions.
